hero.badge: Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4
hero.description: A complete, production-grade foundation with enterprise SEO, toggleable i18n, cookie consent compliance, and modern App Router patterns.

features.heading: Built for scalable production apps
features.subheading: Everything you need to launch immediately without spending days wiring boilerplate.

nextjs.title: Next.js 16 & Turbopack
nextjs.description: Modern App Router, Partial Prerendering (PPR), and Cache Components built for scale and sub-second load times.

i18n.title: Zero-Overhead i18n
i18n.description: Toggleable native internationalization configured directly from site.config.ts with no heavy third-party runtime bloat.

privacy.title: Privacy & GDPR Built-in
privacy.description: Modular cookie consent management, automatic script gating, and legal page wrappers (Privacy, Terms, Cookies).

seo.title: Centralized SEO & Metadata
seo.description: Type-safe metadata inheritance, dynamic OpenGraph / Twitter ImageResponse, and automated sitemap & robots.txt.

modularTypes.title: Modular Type Architecture
modularTypes.description: Strict separation of concerns across domain types (api, config, cookies, legal, seo, schema, stores) with zero duplication.

shadcn.title: Shadcn UI & Tailwind CSS v4
shadcn.description: Extensive library of accessible UI components styled with modern CSS variables, dark mode, and smooth transitions.

webmcp.title: WebMCP & AI Agent Ready
webmcp.description: Google Chrome WebMCP and ARD standards integrated out-of-the-box for autonomous browser AI agent discoverability and execution.

architecture.heading: Core Architecture & Conventions
items: App Router with dynamic [lang] segment support and legacy root compatibility
Modern proxy routing handler (proxy.ts) adhering to Next.js 16 conventions
Fully typed site configuration (site.config.ts) controlling features at runtime
Offline-ready Progressive Web App (PWA) scaffolding with service worker registration
Integrated Orama full-text search engine with client and server index capabilities
Zustand state management and TanStack React Query v5 preconfigured

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, and protect your information across our application and platform.

blocks.text: We are committed to safeguarding personal data and adhering to international privacy standards.
This policy outlines the protocols followed when browsing or interacting with services provided by this application.
We strictly collect the minimum information necessary to operate and secure the platform:

items: Direct User Information: Voluntary communications, account identifiers, or emails provided during contact.
Technical Data: Anonymized browser headers, device characteristics, and session telemetry used for system diagnostics.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing

blocks.text: Information collected is processed exclusively for the following operational needs:

items: Maintaining platform availability and network resilience.
Enforcing security policies and fraud prevention.
Responding to legitimate user support queries.

blocks.text: For questions concerning personal data rights or privacy practices, contact our team through the designated contact channels.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Learn how we use cookies and related tracking technologies to provide, secure, and improve our services.

blocks.text: Cookies and local storage records are small files saved on your device by your browser. They facilitate essential functions, preserve session preferences, and safeguard user choices.
We classify storage and cookie technologies by operational necessity:

items: Strictly Necessary: Essential for routing, security, and consent memory. These cannot be disabled.
Functional & Preferences: Remember chosen UI themes (light/dark) and preferred language selections.
Analytics (Optional): Anonymously evaluate traffic patterns. Only activated upon user consent.

blocks.text: You can modify or withdraw your cookie preferences at any time using the interactive consent banner available across the application.
